name: ThemeFonts
description: Represents a collection of major and minor fonts in the font scheme of a Microsoft Office theme.
example:
Dim tTheme As OfficeTheme
Dim tfThemeFonts As ThemeFonts
Set tfThemeFonts = tTheme.ThemeFontScheme.MinorFont

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ThemeFonts object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ThemeFonts object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ThemeFonts object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the ThemeFonts collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Gets one of the three language fonts contained in the ThemeFonts collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index value of the ThemeFont object.
